Quick thread 🧵
Push to GitHub, launch a server, connect the repo in Deploy Code, set your build and start commands, add a managed database and your environment variables, then point your domain with SSL.
Before any of that, run three quick reviews: read what the agent changed (`git diff`), scrub for hard-coded secrets and paths, and commit your lockfile so the server builds exactly what you tested.
